id.description: Opaque identifier; a string, never a number

course_short_name.description: The course's short name, or null when the route that answered did not carry it

cmid.description: Course module id, for building a link to the activity

cut_off_date.description: After this, Moodle refuses the submission outright; the due date only marks it late.

needs_hand_in.description: Whether saving content leaves the work as a draft, so a separate hand-in is required. Null means the route that answered could not see the setting — reading a page cannot — which is not the same as false.

requires_statement.description: True when the student must accept a submission statement. The tool never accepts it on their behalf.

submission_plugins.description: Submission plugins the assignment has switched on, as Moodle names them (file, onlinetext, comments). Moodle saves all of them in one call, so a submission has to carry data for each.

max_files.description: Null when the site sets no limit, which is not a limit of zero
